behaviors.open-email-normalizer: The new Email normalizer tool appears in the Development category and opens at /email-normalizer.
behaviors.empty-input-state: With no emails entered, the normalized output is empty and the copy button is disabled.
behaviors.normalize-email-lines: Entering emails one per line displays their normalized forms on corresponding output lines.
behaviors.show-invalid-email: An email that cannot be parsed displays an “Unable to parse email” message on its output line.
behaviors.copy-normalized-emails: Copying a nonempty result puts the normalized emails on the clipboard and shows a confirmation toast.
behaviors.clear-emails: Clicking Clear emails empties the raw input and normalized output.
